prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1948 is a strict superset of #1937: it contains the same `mcp.ts` fix and the same `getCapabilities()` change, but additionally guards `sendResourceListChanged()`, `sendToolListChanged()`, and `sendPromptListChanged()` in `index.ts` so notifications cannot fire even if the capability flag is misconfigured upstream. PR #1937 is labeled a backport and lacks these defensive send-method guards.

members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both fix the same bug on v1.x: explicit `listChanged: false` in server capabilities is not respected, causing list-changed notifications to be sent unconditionally. Both make the identical `getCapabilities()` visibility change and the same `mcp.ts` fix (resulting hash `cf4617328` is identical in both). (2 PRs)

members.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1948 is a strict superset of #1937: it contains the same `mcp.ts` fix and the same `getCapabilities()` change, but additionally guards `sendResourceListChanged()`, `sendToolListChanged()`, and `sendPromptListChanged()` in `index.ts` so notifications cannot fire even if the capability flag is misconfigured upstream. PR #1937 is labeled a backport and lacks these defensive send-method guards.
